newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Energy closes 110,000 bpd Mizushima topper.
newsitem.headline: Japan Energy closes 110,000 bpd Mizushima topper.

text.p: Japan Energy Corp said on Friday that it closed its 110,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit at its Mizushima refinery on Wednesday after hydrogen gas leaked from part of the facility.
Japan Energy shut the CDU early Wednesday morning after it detected the gas leak from a desulphurisation unit, a company spokeswoman said.
The cause of the accident is still under investigation, and it is unclear when the refiner will put the CDU back on line, she said.
Operations of the other CDU at the plant have not been affected by the incident, she added.
The topper has a processing capacity of 90,200 bpd.
